svg.title: Aggregation and recovery over two links
svg.desc: The upper time series shows all forty raw one-second bins of aggregate application download throughput, including startup. It combines 3 TCP carriers on one 200 Mbps link with 1 QUIC carrier on another 200 Mbps link. The dashed horizontal line is the configured 200 Mbps capacity of one link; it is a setting reference, not a separately measured TCP throughput series. The TCP link remains configured at 200 Mbps while the QUIC link is shaped. The original 0–15 seconds are the baseline period. The shaded QUIC command window spans 15.44–25.66 seconds. The shaded UDP block runs between recorded transition points at 31.05 and 33.63 seconds. The lower panel plots all eighty successful concurrent echo replies; their measured p95 is 326.5 ms. Whole-transfer aggregate download average: 267.7 Mbps. Measured build: MPTUNNEL 0.6.0, source 1e8abedf.
